stem.text: Two parallel forces, each of magnitude $F$, act on a rod of length $5d$.
Which diagram shows the positions of the two forces that will produce the largest torque on the rod?

A.alt: Horizontal rod with an upward arrow labelled F at its left end and a downward arrow labelled F nearer the left end, with the distance d marked from the left end.

B.alt: Horizontal rod with upward arrows labelled F at both ends.

C.alt: Horizontal rod with an upward arrow labelled F at a point on the rod and an upward arrow labelled F at its right end, with the distance 2d marked between them.

D.alt: Horizontal rod with a downward arrow labelled F at a point on the rod and an upward arrow labelled F to the right, with the distance 2d marked between them.
